as_read: The stored flaxseed lignan trials test a preparation on none of these labels; the labels print sesame seed lignan extract at 10 to 20 mg and HMRlignan spruce extract at 16.7 mg, and no read study qualifies for either at or near those amounts.

quote.text: Twelve subjects were allocated to 4-wk intake of capsules with 60 mg sesamin per day and 13 subjects to 4-wk intake of a placebo (period 1).

proposed_decision_text: Six labels print Sesame Seed Lignan Extract at 10 to 20 mg, beside GLA, CLA blend or vitamin E rows, and three print HMRlignan Norway spruce lignan extract at 16.7 mg inside a chrysin, maca and nettle formula. No label prints flaxseed lignan or a sesamin amount. The stored trials tested flaxseed lignan, 360 mg/day in 17987126 with a modest HbA1c improvement and 50 mg/day SDG in 32575611 with no effect on bile acids, so they do not apply to these labels. For HMRlignan the one human study read, 24606716, is a single-blind dose comparison in 22 women at 36 and 72 mg/d with pharmacokinetic primary outcomes and no placebo; hot flashes fell within the high-dose group only. For sesame lignans, the trials read gave isolated sesamin at 60 mg/day (19352068, blood pressure fell, no primary outcome named) or 200 mg/day (31309643, inflammatory markers and tender joints improved in rheumatoid arthritis, no primary outcome named; 26151734, between-group differences in pressure and most lipids not significant). The meta-analysis 35311241 reports lower total cholesterol, LDL and systolic pressure across seven sesamin trials and 212 participants, but its abstract gives no dose and names no primary outcome. 26153159 tested sesame lignans at the labels' 10 mg, combined with vitamin E, with no significant between-group difference overall. These reads are of abstracts only, and an abstract that names no primary outcome counts against qualifying for no credit.
stop_list: Sesame labels print extract mass with no sesamin amount, and trials print isolated sesamin, so doses can't be compared without a conversion the sources do not give.
HMRlignan labels are multi-ingredient formulas with no study of that formula read.
stored_rating_note: The stored material_form is flaxseed lignan (SDG), which no label in this set prints, so the stored record's mixed rating rests on a preparation outside these labels.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. 8724120 has no abstract on PubMed (a letter), so nothing is claimed from it. Sesame search returned 24, spruce search 21. Left unread: whole sesame or sesame oil reviews and trials (35043479, 28387047, 35619269, 19346113, 16614415, 18541561, 31373097), combinations (29614679, 29495607, 22610748, 24659610, 21234288), pharmacokinetics 24014208, 19786646, and 37033930 (polyphenols in RA). 41637231 was cut at 1800 characters and covers whole sesame in athletes, not a label preparation. Spruce hits other than 24606716 were lab, animal, topical or method papers by title and first lines.
